description:
[Game reference] Playable instruments: notes, mouse notes, octaves, keyboard maps, autoplay songs. Every instrument (`item` shortname, `name`, `dlc`): `notes` (pitch names, lowest first; drum kit = drum
pieces), `lowest`/`highest`, `primary_click`/`secondary_click` (mouse notes), `default_octave`/`shifted_octave`,
`max_notes_at_once`, `keyboard` (full-keyboard mode: key label -> note, UK QWERTY as the game's map), `song` (the
built-in autoplay song: `notes`, `seconds`, `lowest`/`highest`, `chords` - described, no audio). `tips`: the game's
own control tips.
name: get_instruments
title: Playable instruments: notes, mouse notes, octaves, keyboard maps, autoplay songs
